question: The first woman of Indian origin to travel into space was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalpana Chawla**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kalpana Chawla** was the first woman of Indian origin to go to space.
 
• She first flew on the **Space Shuttle Columbia** in 1997 as a mission specialist and primary robotic arm operator.
